name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage development company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta Province, Argentina. The Diablillos deposit is one of the world's largest undeveloped primary silver resources, with Measured and Indicated Resources totaling approximately 248 Moz silver and 2.54 Moz gold, underpinned by a completed Definitive Feasibility Study. The company received final environmental approval in June 2026 and is backed by strategic shareholders including Kinross Gold and Eric Sprott.
